name: Ana Kovačić
bio:
Ana Kovačić's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While pursuing a degree in engineering, she volunteered at a local karting track, quickly becoming fascinated by the intricate mechanics and the relentless pursuit of performance. After graduating, Ana bypassed traditional engineering roles to work directly with race teams, initially as a data analyst before transitioning to test driver coordination. Her sharp analytical skills and ability to anticipate potential issues proved invaluable. 

Ana's approach to coordinating test drivers is meticulous and proactive. She believes in fostering open communication and ensuring every test session yields actionable data. Her focus is on maximizing track time and providing drivers with the resources they need to push the limits safely. What sets her apart is her ability to bridge the gap between engineering and driver feedback, translating complex technical data into practical insights for improving car performance.
